title: Sharp Two-Point Escape and Logarithmic Communication for Johnson Products and Sparse Columns
description:
Reviewer and source repository for the manuscript Sharp Two-Point Escape and Logarithmic Communication for Johnson Products and Sparse Columns.

The archive contains the LaTeX source, a compiled PDF, a curated Lean 4 core, and deterministic Python audits. The results are restricted-column theorems for the HLS two-level formulation of the log-rank conjecture. They do not prove the general conjecture or improve the universal O(sqrt(r)) communication bound.
